background: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. is the main operating bank of Wells Fargo, one of the four largest US banks, with the largest branch network in the country, serving consumers, small businesses and corporates across the United States.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, AA- on average and the weakest of them at A+, all on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 7 Feb 2018. Leverage of 8.0% is in the top quarter of US banks and LCR of 119% is above the median, while CET1 of 12.1% is just below it and has fallen 1.2 points since 30 Jun 2025. The newest flagged item, on 5 Oct 2026, is an analyst upgrade of the stock, and the rest are warnings on layoffs and an old fine over unauthorised accounts rather than anything touching its credit.
